verse.verse_1: Read! In the Name of your Lord Who created.
verse.verse_2: He has created man from a clot.
verse.verse_3: Read! And your Lord is the Most Generous.
verse.verse_4: Who has taught by the pen.
verse.verse_5: He has taught man that which he knew not.
verse.verse_8: Surely, unto your Lord is the return.
verse.verse_9: Have you seen him who prevents
verse.verse_11: Have you seen if he is on the guidance
verse.verse_13: Have you seen if he denies and turns away
verse.verse_14: Knows he not that Allah sees
verse.verse_15: Nay! If he ceases not, We will scorch his forehead --
verse.verse_17: Then let him call upon his council.
verse.verse_18: We will call out the guards of Hell!
verse.verse_19: Nay! Do not obey him. Fall prostrate and draw near (to Allah)!
